overview: Global developments include rising security concerns in Europe and ongoing conflicts, while domestic markets focus on key election outcomes and administrative shifts. In commercial real estate, major firms are reporting solid quarterly earnings, active leasing activity, and strategic property transactions. San Francisco voters head to the polls for consequential local elections and decisions regarding major regional public transit funding. Meanwhile, Hawaii residents monitor important state governance reports, ongoing land lease discussions, and housing affordability pressures.

items.title: Poland Beefs Up Security at Border With Russia
items.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk reported disturbing military movements in the Russian region of Kaliningrad, prompting increased border security.

items.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
items.summary: Russian attacks across Ukraine hit an aid center, hospice, and hospital, raising the death toll by at least 38 people within 24 hours.

items.title: Vornado Reports Strong Q3 Cash Flow, Revenue Behind Brisk Office Leasing
items.summary: Vornado Realty Trust reported strong third-quarter cash flow and revenue driven by brisk office leasing and robust capital markets metrics.

items.title: BKM Capital Buys Orange County, Calif., Industrial Park for $62M
items.summary: BKM Capital Partners acquired a fully leased, 231,000-square-foot industrial business park in Orange County, California, for $62 million.

items.title: Election Day: Big money, high stakes, and key contests to watch
items.summary: San Francisco voters face high-stakes contests on Election Day involving supervisors, congressional seats, a billionaire tax, and CEQA reform.

items.title: This is the biggest election for Bay Area public transit since 1962
items.summary: BART and Caltrain face potential service cuts unless they secure additional funding from a major new regional transit tax measure.

items.title: Army proposes ending leases on state lands ahead of expiration
items.summary: The Army has proposed officially terminating its leases on several parcels of state land ahead of expiration, including in Makua Valley.

items.title: Mortgage Payments Soar, Locking Many Out Of Housing Market
items.summary: Rising mortgage payments and costs are locking many buyers out of the housing market, causing homes to sit longer for sale.

wiki.title: Ich geh und suche mit Verlangen, BWV 49
wiki.extract: Johann Sebastian Bach composed the church cantata Ich geh und suche mit Verlangen, BWV 49, in Leipzig for the twentieth Sunday after Trinity Sunday and first performed it on 3 November 1726. It is a solo cantata, a dialogue for soprano and bass.

otd.text: A CIA drone strike kills six militants in Yemen, constituting the first targeted killing of the war on terror.
Abdullah Çatlı, a leader of the ultra-nationalist Grey Wolves, was killed in a car crash near Susurluk, Turkey, sparking a scandal that exposed the depth of the state's complicity in organized crime.
